No resolved item was relabeled.

VERIFIED (prepare, fail-closed + preservation): prepare_completion_fixture requires the exact original consumed fixture (sources==[OLD], max_model_turns==1, writer_config None, runtime source OLD, no existing synthetic_execution), a new 40-hex pin distinct from OLD, the installed OLD symlink and pinned EXECUTOR, inactive controller service+timer, exactly one original turn with all three stage receipts and broker-verified COMPLETE status, ledger count 1, and no incomplete coordinator work — every check raises before mutation. VERIFIED (start, bounded + no-retry): start_completion_fixture refuses without the migrated bounded config (purpose, SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE, SUPERVISED, writer_config None, max_model_turns 3, report_schedule None, exactly one OPERATOR_SUPERVISED_SYNTHETIC_ONLY pair), refuses if the start marker, runtime timer unit, or either job id already exists, and never retries. The 30-minute transient stop is armed via systemd-run before the parent submit, matching the docstring; submission runs as the existing non-root research-controller identity with scrubbed env and PYTHONPATH pinned to the installed executor root; the temporary /run timer only triggers the non-root controller unit and cannot survive reboot. Receipt claims (no permanent timer, no live activation, no patient execution, max 6 new model calls) match the code.

VERIFIED (identity bindings): EXECUTOR is pinned by resolving /opt/research-system/current at prepare time and re-verified at every CompletionBridge construction via checked_source; advance() re-derives the expected proposal from root-owned installed config, re-checks the observed attempt id against the stored event, and byte-compares the durable intent file before the idempotent Controller.submit, so neither the model answer nor a mutated DB row can redirect dispatch; select_next re-validation limits the model to the configured successor or an explicit decline.

VERIFIED (privacy + persistent artifacts): evidence directories are root-only (0700); model-facing observation evidence carries hash-bound completion events (digests, not console bytes) in non-root controller state; no patient-data path exists in either script; and HANDOVER_COMPLETION_BRIDGE_REVIEW_20260907.json honestly records requested vs actual model usage (auxiliary claude-haiku call disclosed), its non-independent status, and inference-labeled investigator notes — no history rewritten as approval.

SUGGESTION (prepare archive TOCTOU, inferred): prepare hashes archive bytes via read_bytes() but reopens the path twice (validate_members and extractall) and, unlike install_handover_fixture, never refuses a symlinked archive; a swap between hash and extract would install unhashed bytes as root. Low likelihood for a one-time root-operated script with an operator-supplied path. Smallest fix: refuse symlinks and extract from the already-hashed bytes (tarfile.open(fileobj=BytesIO(raw))); install has the same read-then-reopen gap minus the symlink issue.

SUGGESTION (finish() retry, untested): finish() writes the selected-dispatch intent with immutable() without the read-if-exists pattern ingest() uses for observations; if immutable() refuses byte-identical rewrites, a crash between the intent write and the selected_dispatch insert leaves a task that can never finish — fail-closed availability only, no authority impact. Smallest fix: mirror ingest()'s exists-first reuse or confirm immutable() tolerates identical rewrites.

SUGGESTION (controller unit sandbox, untested): research-system-handover-controller.service sets ProtectSystem=strict with ReadWritePaths limited to the two state dirs; client connect() to the broker unix socket at /run/research-system/handover.sock from a read-only /run can fail with EROFS. Completed original-turn receipts suggest it works as deployed, so verify at activation only; if connects fail, smallest fix is ReadWritePaths=/run/research-system.

NOTE (coverage): test_completion_fixture_plan exercises broker-side tamper cases but not runtime-side ones (runtime source != OLD, pre-existing synthetic_execution); start_completion_fixture has no unit tests (root/systemd side effects); the observation filename embeds the controller-issued attempt_id without identifier() validation — trusted store, hardening only.
